purpose: Sanitized public decision summary, not private approval evidence
code_license_scope: Only Python files explicitly listed in code_license_scope.json
document_license_scope: Only author-owned original prose in document_license_scope.json; third-party and data exceptions
private_review_policy: The author-side checker may use an explicitly supplied review directory outside this package. Internal statements, emails and signatures are not public payload. A status string alone never grants publication permission.
data_license_scope: Only author-licensable original contributions in data_license_scope.json; third-party exceptions preserved
status_context: Historical pre-publication approval flags are retained below; they do not describe current GitHub visibility or certify third-party rights clearance. Current PUBLIC status is recorded separately.

current_repository_status.verification_basis: GitHub API; verification date is not the original publication date

current_maintenance_authorization.basis: Explicit author instruction for this maintenance task on 2026-10-16; not private rights-review evidence
current_maintenance_authorization.scope: Existing tracked documentation, citation and release/hash metadata only

scope_sha256_context: Current payload digest for consistency checks, excluding this authorization record and the allowlist to avoid cycles; historical_scope_sha256 preserves the pre-maintenance digest. Neither digest creates approval evidence.
